messages:
hana: Quick question during onboarding: planning an external demo next Friday using streaming. Sandbox seems fine but I keep hitting 429s when multiple people connect. Should I request a hosted demo key?

marta (onboarding): For external demos we prefer hosted demo tokens — more predictable concurrency/quota. Internal rehearsals can usually use sandbox but expect lower limits.

ops-bot: sandbox quota for hana@example.com -> 40 req/min, 4k tokens/day. Hosted dev tier -> 20 req/min. Request hosted-demo via #eng-infra. (auto)

jordan (eng-infra): @hana send the 429 payload and approx concurrency. If it's concurrent streams limit we can spin up a temporary hosted token for the event (24h TTL). Try adding a 100ms jitter too.

hana: Error: {"error":"rate_limit","type":"concurrent_streams"}. It happens when 5+ participants open streams.

jordan (eng-infra): Ok that looks like concurrent limit. I'll ask ops to create a hosted-demo token with elevated concurrency for your event. Also recommend using ephemeral attendee keys for each participant to avoid sharing.

sam (devex): FYI Console->API Keys has "Create ephemeral key" (30m TTL) which is handy. Also we have a small demo checklist in the devex docs (link) to avoid NAT bursting.

jordan (eng-infra): @ops please provision hosted-demo token for hana's event.

ops-bot: Provisioned hosted-demo token (sent to hana DM) TTL 24h, concurrency 200 req/min.

hana: Got it, retested and looks good, no 429s. Thanks! If we need a 3-day pilot boost for sandbox later, what's the process?

marta (onboarding): Fill the "Sandbox quota increase" form in onboarding docs and CC your manager + eng-infra. Approval usually 1-2 business days.

hana: Great — appreciate the help!
